texture_mpaa_{rating_system}.note: String.Contains ignores case, so a one-letter rung would match any reason text ('Rated R for strong language' holds a g): it matches only as the whole label, after 'Rated ' or after a country code's colon, and tests after the longer rungs (the second row).
